# Global Public Surface — Phase Three Execution

The Awtsmoos gathers every true doorway into a constellation that can be found;
Awtsmoos.com keeps the first layer quiet and futuristic, while deeper tools unfold without breaking the bound.

## Exact execution order

1. Read `/apps/index.html`, `/games/index.html`, and every manifest/script directly responsible for rendering those catalogs.
2. Census canonical top-level product entries from `apps/*/index.html` and `games/*/index.html`, plus explicitly productized nested routes already referenced by catalog data.
3. Diff catalog URLs against entry routes after canonical normalization.
4. Record missing, duplicate, stale, and dead catalog entries.
5. If catalog data lives in small modules, rewrite those modules completely. If it lives in legacy large markup, add a small data/polish module rather than extending a monolith.
6. Verify every added route exists and appears in rendered catalog DOM.
7. Verify `/apps` and `/games` at desktop, 390×844, and 320×568: no horizontal overflow, no clipped cards/actions, no raw tail, no menu escape.
8. Runtime-probe Rebbe overlays next because it is the highest clean handwritten UI-risk family from the last scan.
9. Continue through the risk list: Universal Chat, DB Explorer, Code menus, Drive site-builder dock, CSV, Lyric Sync, Archive Uploader, then remaining game HUD/control families.
10. Apply compact mode only to module browser entries that pass targeted `compactJs` compilation and generated syntax checking.

## Rewrite law

Every touched source file is read fully first and rewritten fully. Legacy files above the modular ceiling are not grown. New responsibility belongs in a small module loaded at the appropriate late layer.

## Verification law

A route is not improved because CSS changed. It is improved only when the failing viewport/state is measured after the rewrite and the defect disappears without a regression in existing working states.
